race.comment: ZIPPY LION (1) comes through a BM60 at Canberra where he raced wide and was just fair in the finish. He' ll be better for that run at this distance however and he looks to get every chance in the small field. Back to a CL1 here and he makes the most appeal. IRON REBEL (2) is the most progressive in this field, being a 3YO who closed strongly over the mile last start at Canberra. Up in trip now is the query, but he's shaping as a staying type and the wet deck shouldn't be an issue. DON'T BACK DOWN (7) was back in trip last start when behind IRON REBEL, but his run prior over 2000m makes for good reading. Can bounce back to her best getting out in distance again. KAMAROOKA (4) comes up from Victoria and has her first run for the new stable. Keep safe.
